# Apache Wayang

> Apache Wayang is an open-source framework for cross-platform data processing. Applications express a pipeline through a common API; Wayang plans its execution across registered processing engines.

Apache Wayang is a project of the Apache Software Foundation, licensed under Apache License 2.0. Its cost-based optimizer considers processing and data movement when choosing execution plans. Available capabilities depend on the release and installed platform plugins; consult the documentation for API coverage and setup requirements.

These links point to the official project website and documentation. Commercial offerings are provided independently by third parties and are not endorsed by Apache Wayang or the Apache Software Foundation.

## Project overview

- [What is Apache Wayang?](https://wayang.apache.org/docs/introduction/about): Architecture and project overview.
- [Features](https://wayang.apache.org/docs/introduction/features): Cross-platform execution and extensibility.
- [Benchmarks](https://wayang.apache.org/docs/introduction/benchmark): Published scenarios, measurements, and methodology.
- [Downloads](https://wayang.apache.org/docs/start/download): Releases and download instructions.

- [Optimizer](https://wayang.apache.org/docs/guide/optimizer): Cost-based execution planning.
